messages.author: c8b54e5b6d11208b
messages.subject: error in aboot()
parts:
Dear Zhian,

Recently I successfully run my data using aboot() to calculate dendrogram with bootstrap. But, once I did some updates on my R packages (all) including install several new other packages, I got an error message using the same code for bootstrap. However, I don't think it was due to my recent updates but probably some thing else.

The code that I run is as follow:

data(snp_nin)  ##snps data of one population (a genind object)
set.seed(999)
aboot(snp_nin, dist = provesti.dist, sample = 1000, tree = "upgma", cutoff = 0, quiet = TRUE)

I got warning of...

invalid length in loc.n.all
Error in validObject(x) : invalid class “bootgen” object: FALSE

Thanks in advance,

Yayan
